Enum Class PieceType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PieceType>
chess.pieces.PieceType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PieceType>, Constable
public enum PieceType extends Enum<PieceType>
The six kinds of chess piece, with the data that does not depend on color.

Phase 1 repeated the board code and name in every subclass (getSymbol() and getName() overrides). Phase 2 keeps that data in one place here, and each subclass only reports its type through Piece.getType(). The enum is also what PieceFactory uses to decide which subclass to build, which is how promotion and board setup create pieces.
